correctness.rationale: The proof identifies R(-hL), reconstructs Taylor-remainder positivity of every diagonal, and exhausts relevant graph walks through length four. The seven distance-one cubics and five distance-two quadratics have strictly positive Bernstein coefficients on [0,2/3]; exact distance-three witnesses force all large-graph sharp cutoffs with strict negativity above. Exceptional low orders are controlled by four strictly decreasing cubics, with remaining off-diagonal quadratics strictly positive. This reconstructs both iff directions and excludes later positivity recovery. The packaged stdlib checker independently recomputes short-distance polynomials and 245752 exact-rational entry tests; finite tests are not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The canonical symmetric finite-difference heat generator on every path and cycle is a meaningful sharp-step test for classical RK4: general positivity radii alone cannot tell whether its full end-step stays nonnegative for this restricted family. This theorem gives exact necessary and sufficient values for every dimension, identifies a universal large-size half-step frontier, and exposes two strict nonmonotonic cycle-size effects. This is an infinite structural classification with potential numerical-method design use, not an arbitrary table recomputation.
